purpose: Creat Pack: local release toolkit, AI adapter starter and Release Assistant CLI
runtime_requirements: Windows, Linux or macOS; UTF-8 filesystem

input_contract.build: Source root plus config/package.json, output directory outside source root
input_contract.inspect: Untrusted ZIP; read only, no execution

output_contract.cli: JSON on stdout; nonzero exit on failure
output_contract.release: ZIP, MANIFEST.json within ZIP, SHA256SUMS.txt and RELEASE-RECEIPT.json outside ZIP
output_contract.worker: Durable local journal and JSON receipt, no live provider

authentication_requirements: Live AI provider implementation is not included; credentials must stay external
known_limits: Signature-based secret scan does not detect every possible secret
No automatic execution of input source or its tests
Test claims for arbitrary input are UNVERIFIED
Windows validated locally; Linux/macOS execution UNVERIFIED
Commercial pricing and customer terms are undecided
Manifest does not hash itself; external ZIP hash covers it
Archive inspector rejects nested ZIPs and files over 20 MiB
